landing.badge: Free · Open source · Runs in your browser
landing.headline:
Edit JSON
without friction.
landing.subheadline: Tree view, table view, a code editor, diff and merge. Everything runs in your browser, and nothing is uploaded.
landing.localProcessing: Everything runs in your browser. Your JSON is never uploaded to a server.
landing.noDataSent: Runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

tree.title: Tree editor
tree.description: Navigate nested JSON visually. Click any value to edit in place.

table.title: Table view
table.description: Arrays of objects unfold into editable spreadsheet-style tables.

diff.title: JSON diff
diff.description: See every change highlighted side by side.

export.title: Export anywhere
export.description: Export as JSON, plain text, JavaScript object, or PHP array.

merge.title: JSON merge
merge.description: Deep-merge two documents. Override wins, arrays replace or concat.

editor.confirmClear: Clear all data. This cannot be undone.
editor.invalidJsonFile: Invalid JSON file. Please check the format.
editor.treeEditorHint: Click any value to edit · arrays open as table
editor.noDataHint: Choose a file, paste JSON, or drop a file anywhere. It stays in your browser.
editor.shortcutHint: Shift+Alt+F format · Ctrl+Shift+M minify · Ctrl+F find
editor.jsonDiffHint: Paste two JSON documents to see differences highlighted
editor.clipboardDenied: Clipboard access blocked. Paste into the text box instead.
editor.jsonMergeHint: Keys in Override win. Nested objects are merged recursively.
editor.mergeEmpty: Paste valid JSON into both Base and Override to see the merged result.

showcase.title: Five ways to look at the same data
showcase.subtitle: Every view edits the same document, so you can switch whenever it helps.

dropZone.title: Drop a JSON file here
dropZone.subtitle: or click to choose one. It opens straight in the editor.
dropZone.clipboardDenied: Clipboard access was blocked. Open the editor and paste with Ctrl+V.
